Class ProtectionScenarios

java.lang.Object
com.github.crittscott.somebuckets.gametest.ProtectionScenarios
final class ProtectionScenarios extends Object
Cross-loader protection and authorization scenarios; each loader wraps every method as a GameTest.

    • withoutBuildPermission

      static boolean withoutBuildPermission(net.minecraft.world.entity.player.Player actor, BooleanSupplier action)
      Runs action with actor's build permission withdrawn, restoring it before returning. The automation player is shared by every test in the level, so the withdrawal must never outlive one synchronous call.

    • outsideWorldBorder

      static <R> R outsideWorldBorder(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper, Supplier<R> action)
      Runs action with the level's world border moved far from every test structure, restoring it before returning. The border is shared by every test in the level, so the change must never outlive one synchronous call.
